findings.name: Emoji as interface icons
findings.why: Emoji standing in for iconography in features, nav, or footers.

findings.name: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur)
findings.why: Frosted surfaces by reflex; keep blur only where layering is real, like a nav over scrolling content.

findings.name: Purple / indigo gradient
findings.why: The canonical unchosen gradient (the Tailwind indigo-500 lineage).

findings.name: Gradient-filled headline text
findings.why: bg-clip-text gradients are a 2024-era default flourish that also hurts legibility.

findings.name: Pill badge + centered hero
findings.why: Badge, centered H1, centered subhead, two centered CTAs: the landing-page skeleton that makes no spatial decision.

findings.name: Indigo / violet primary buttons
findings.why: The accent defaulted instead of being chosen.

findings.name: The worn Lucide set / the sparkle-for-AI glyph
findings.why: Sparkles, Zap, Rocket, Shield, BarChart3, ArrowRight in the same roles, and a sparkle beside anything 'AI'.

findings.name: One radius + soft shadow on every surface
findings.why: Identical radius and shadow everywhere flattens hierarchy into a template.

findings.name: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur)
findings.why: Frosted surfaces by reflex; keep blur only where layering is real, like a nav over scrolling content.

findings.name: Cream ground + terracotta/clay accent (the Claude look)
findings.why: The warm-cream + terracotta cluster (#F4F1EA / #D97757 territory) is what models reach for to look tasteful.

findings.name: Template chrome: tracked ALL-CAPS labels
findings.why: An uppercase, letter-spaced label on everything is chrome that appears whatever the subject.

findings.name: One word accented in the headline
findings.why: Coloring, italicizing, or highlighting a single headline word is among the commonest tells of a generated page.

findings.name: Decorative 01 / 02 / 03 markers
findings.why: Two-digit numerals are only information when the content is a real sequence; otherwise they are decoration.

findings.name: Colored glow shadows
findings.why: A saturated shadow is decoration that says nothing about elevation.

findings.name: Template chrome: monospace as small data labels
findings.why: A mono face for tiny labels and readouts is decoration standing in for information design.

findings.name: Emerald as the purple-avoiding accent
findings.why: When purple is ruled out, emerald is the model's next reflex; it is still a default unless the brief earns it.

findings.name: The worn Lucide set / the sparkle-for-AI glyph
findings.why: Sparkles, Zap, Rocket, Shield, BarChart3, ArrowRight in the same roles, and a sparkle beside anything 'AI'.

findings.name: Icon in a tinted rounded square
findings.why: The stock 'feature icon' treatment, one chip per card.

findings.name: Template chrome: meta strings joined with middle dots
findings.why: 'A · B · C' metadata strings are a stock chrome move, not a decision about this content.
